title: BRAKE PEDAL HOUSING, REINF. & COVER
summary: Brake pedal housing (pedal support box on the driver's side of the dash/firewall) with its bottom reinforcement plate and the cover-bracket over it. The reinforcement is riveted to the housing, a strap on the housing side is riveted, and the cover-bracket is glued to the body with 56e adhesive (bonds F and G) and screwed into the housing with screws [2].

materials.where: View A, around the edges of cover-bracket [6] (BOND F along the top, BOND G down the inner edge, and the lower edge)

fastening.to: body at the upper corner of the housing
fastening.note: Main view: screw [2] goes into the upper right flange of the housing [1] (torque 1). What it threads into is not clear from the drawing.
View A: screws [2] pass through two holes in the cover-bracket [6] into nuts on the housing behind it (torque 3).
View A: cover-bracket [6] edges bonded with 56e adhesive at BOND F (top) and BOND G (inner side) and along the bottom edge.
Rivets [7] go through the lower part of the reinforcement [4] at the front of the housing; .192/.199 dia. holes, 2 places.

fastening.to: strap along the lower side of the housing
fastening.note: Rivets [3] go down through the strap/flange along the right side of the housing [1].
